subject.title: feat: generic session discussion seam with Control UI panel

question: Should OpenClaw expose a single process-wide, replacement-based public session-discussion provider contract, after its activation lifecycle is made transactional?
rationale: This is an additive public plugin SDK and Gateway surface whose single-slot ownership semantics determine how independent plugins can coexist; that durable product contract cannot be selected mechanically.

options.title: Approve the single-provider seam
options.body: Repair lifecycle snapshot/restore/clear behavior and document that one active provider intentionally owns the discussion surface.

options.title: Require a different ownership model
options.body: Redesign the SDK contract before merge if multiple providers, explicit selection, or a plugin-owned presentation path is required.

recommendation.title: Approve the single-provider seam
recommendation.body: Repair lifecycle snapshot/restore/clear behavior and document that one active provider intentionally owns the discussion surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied branch history shows this contributor authored the proposed SDK, Gateway, and Control UI contract.
